## Start here

Results [the one page](theories/becoming/ONE-PAGE.md) leans on, chosen by an AI reader: a way in, not a ranking. Each opens with the one page's plain line, then its record's statement and its standing in its homes' words, and holds under the hypotheses its record states. An automated review against the literature it knew, not exhaustive, finds [none of the central results new mathematics](theories/becoming/chapters/08-METHOD.md#known-results).

- **[Continuation relative to a class](theories/becoming/results/records/continuation-relative-to-a-class.md)** ([home section](theories/becoming/chapters/01-ROOT.md#r-continuation-relative-to-a-class)). Sameness is in some respect, a *class*. Where one occurrence conditions another alike under the class, the second *continues* it. *Its record:* For every carrier and relation, continuation is 缘 ([condition](GLOSSARY.md#the-root), *yuán*) met with a class; its positions depend on the class, a class constant under 缘 never lets a continuation end, a line's own regularity is the class's core, and the World model's arising, ceasing, lineage and passing are its instances. *Its standing:* Theorems for every relation and class, so they forbid no relation. That this explains how things go on: argued. That every becoming fits it: open. `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded.
- **[Selection through the couplings](theories/becoming/results/records/selection-through-couplings.md)** ([home section](theories/becoming/chapters/03-KNOWING.md#r-selection-through-couplings)). The selections through a selector's couplings (what it reads or needs), together, reach exactly what couples into it. *Its record:* Every selection through a selector's couplings selects histories alike exactly when they are alike through them. With the rest fixed, selection is blind beyond the coupling closure; pooled couplings select an ending beyond it within reach, and a flow raising what couples in from beyond is selected. *Its standing:* Proved, near-definitional; its force is the premise that a selector selects through just those. `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded.
- **[What an optimum does beyond what couples in](theories/becoming/results/records/what-an-optimum-does-beyond-what-couples-in.md)** ([home section](theories/becoming/chapters/05-COLLECTIVES.md#r-what-an-optimum-does-beyond-what-couples-in)). With *room* (every eligible outcome left higher beyond is beaten on what couples in), every optimum of an order rising with what couples in drains what lies beyond as far as any eligible outcome does. *Its record:* Every order rising with what couples in has its optima least beyond exactly where no eligible outcome above another beyond is unbeaten on it; an optimum breaks exactly the dependences beyond some outcome breaks; raising the family is lowering the beyond with the loss; keeping each takes the slack. *Its standing:* Proved; a known theorem restated. `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded.
- **[Closed capture: a loop whose every level reads only the share](theories/becoming/results/records/closed-capture.md)** ([home section](theories/becoming/chapters/02-MAP.md#r-closed-capture)). A rule read from the share it raises can lock and outlive a growing loss it does not read. *Its record:* In a selection whose rule, and how the rule is read, are read from the share it selects, a loss the loop does not read leaves it locked however large it grows, and a change of the reading is absorbed; what leaves is a change of the law, such as a reading of what lies beyond the share. *Its standing:* Proved for any type, in the model only, without noise; drawn one member at a time, the critical mass's locks are left by drift alone, with no new reader and no change in what is read, at a weight whose bound shrinks across the distance from the mass ([drawn one at a time](theories/becoming/chapters/02-MAP.md#r-drawn-shaping-drawn-one-at-a-time)); for capture through the rule this is a reading ([which locks noise leaves](theories/becoming/chapters/02-MAP.md#which-locks-noise-leaves)). `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded.
- **[Counting one's own draw misses joint excess](theories/becoming/results/records/own-count-misses-joint-excess.md)** ([home section](theories/becoming/chapters/05-COLLECTIVES.md#r-own-count-misses-joint-excess)). Takers each within what a renewal gives can together exceed it; where the renewal depends on what it renews, enough such steps in a row from a low enough level end it and what depends on the condition as much. *Its record:* Formations each taking within what is given can together exceed it; with natural-number amounts, joint excess cannot outlast what was held. Where renewers depend on what they renew, it ends the renewal and those depending at such a need, a taker among them where it so depends. *Its standing:* Proved on models; restates the commons. `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded.
- **[One root to its edge: where each central declaration stands](theories/becoming/results/records/one-root-to-its-edge.md)** ([home section](theories/becoming/chapters/08-METHOD.md#r-one-root-to-its-edge)). Of the central results a few are cases of the root, more use its laws in their proofs and most use none. *Its record:* Each central declaration has one standing against the edge of one root: on it, derived from grammar laws or under a stated hypothesis; counting, below the grammar; or a named distance with its reason. None is a premise: the ethics' two, the condition for scope and C for order, are listed apart. `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded.

No law here evaluates; each ranking result names what it ranks under, most often two readings, neither asserted: [the continuation condition fixes scope, and C gives order](theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order).

## Where to look first

- Same theorem under two names: `trace-law-equivalence`, `derivation-soundness`. Preserve historical names and receipts; count the underlying result once.
- Similar statements with different semantics: `branching-target-uniqueness`, `joint-target-uniqueness`. Their local test languages differ.
- Three shared-support results: `draws-on-a-shared-stock`, `exclusive-footprint-support`, `joint-plan-composition`. Their common obstruction does not establish a verified translation between them.
- Completed conditional alignment argument and its AI application: `practical-judgment-under-living-significance`, `alignment-direction-under-widening`. The question `universal-practical-warrant` and the independent target `wisdom-root` remain open.

## How this register is kept

The single register of results: one editable JSON record per migrated claim, from which this page and each record page are generated. Hash drift requires reading the changed source before updating its record.

## Discovery and evidence

[The one page](theories/becoming/ONE-PAGE.md) · [The overview](theories/becoming/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md) · [The eight chapters](theories/becoming/chapters/README.md) · [The theory graph](theories/becoming/results/THEORY-GRAPH.md) · [Broader theory map](MAP.md). Earlier catalogues: [chapter readings of 8 October 2026 and later](theories/becoming/results/README.md) · [the generativity chain, kept since 8 October 2026](theories/becoming/results/GENERATIVITY-CHAIN.md).

```sh
make research-check
make research-find QUERY=your-topic
make research-render
```

Default discovery excludes frozen copies and failed build attempts. Use `--archives` deliberately to include them. Checks concern metadata and evidence bindings; mathematical changes retain their actual Lean-build requirement.
